claim: retrospective next-public-revelation diagnostic, not exact-set/spread accuracy or battle strength
source_time_limit: current curated and September 2026 usage snapshots postdate many source games; not forward-time deployment evidence
move_model: uniform over candidate moves not previously observed; not a calibrated action policy
selection: fixed bounded Tiger sample; no mixture tuning on these scores

paired_test_battle_bootstrap.metric: mixture minus baseline observed-facts loss; lower is better
paired_test_battle_bootstrap.unit: whole battle; does not control repeated-player/roster dependence

equivalence_note: Version 2, version 3 and final exporter produce byte-identical evidence on this frozen sample; the final hash refactor changes only memory use/provenance.
